question: Which of the following is the shortcut key to create a new paragraph in MS Word?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Enter**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enter** is the shortcut key to create a new paragraph in MS Word.
 
• Pressing **Enter** will move the cursor to the next line and start a new paragraph.
 
• This is different from **Shift + Enter**, which creates a line break within the same paragraph.
 
• Using the correct shortcut keys can significantly improve your efficiency while working in MS Word.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ctrl + N** is used to create a new document in MS Word.
 
• **Ctrl + P** is used to open the print dialog box in MS Word.
 
• Learning and utilizing MS Word shortcut keys can make document editing and formatting much faster and more convenient.
